candidates.title: node: Upgrade go-libp2p to v0.46.0
candidates.body:
## Summary

Upgrade go-libp2p from v0.37.0 to v0.46.0. This change keeps Go at 1.25.10.

The Go 1.26 upgrade (#4828) needs this change. go-libp2p v0.37.0 uses quic-go v0.48.1. On Go 1.26, quic-go v0.48.1 panics in the server handshake when the TLS config disables session tickets. libp2p always sets this option, so a guardian built with Go 1.26 crashes on inbound connections. The `tilt` and `node-tests` jobs on #4828 show this panic.

quic-go v0.57.1 fixes the panic (quic-go/quic-go#5462). The quic-go project did not backport the fix to older versions. quic-go v0.57.1 does not compile with go-l

candidates.title: node: Upgrade to Go 1.26
candidates.body:
Updates the Guardian code to use 1.26 at the latest release on that line.

This necessitates bumping some dependencies (see https://github.com/wormhole-foundation/wormhole/pull/5070). That PR contains just the dependency bumps against `1.25`. It's probably best that we merge that PR separately from this one. That should help us isolate any problems in case we need to rollback.
